capabilities: Build editable agent org charts with delegation and reviewer verify loops
Chat with agents powered by local CLI tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes
Run projects with saved memory, cost limits and a project board
Schedule recurring tasks and repeat loops until a reviewer approves
Let agents write notes, reorganise folders, browse the web and read Microsoft 365 behind Approve cards
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free and MIT-licensed with Ko-fi donations; guides live at trabalhoia.com. Windows is the tested platform; macOS is supported in code but untested. Requires Obsidian desktop on Windows or Mac.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run multiple cooperating AI agents that delegate work, remember project context and act on notes on a schedule.
